description: Report a wrong, incomplete, or unhelpful findtime.io MCP answer. Call this after a tool result that you or the user judged incorrect. Required: tool, query, and whatWasWrong. Optional: expectedAnswer. Only the tool name is sent to findtime.io; the query, expected answer, and other free text stay local and are discarded. Never send names, emails, phone numbers, IP addresses, or raw user ids.

_endUserId.description: Optional opaque per-call end-user attribution token populated by the MCP host, not the LLM. Use a non-PII hash or token; never send raw email, name, or platform user ID.

expectedAnswer.description: Optional correct time, timezone, or location the tool should have returned.

query.description: Original time query or lookup text. Strip names, emails, and other personal data first.

tool.description: MCP tool that produced the unhelpful result, such as answer_time_question, convert_time, or get_current_time.

whatWasWrong.description: Short description of the mistake or why the answer was unhelpful.

name: send_feedback
